※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
眼皮颤动，华十二自昏迷中苏醒，慢慢睁开眼帘，入眼一片白色，赫然是一间病房之中，此时的他正躺在一张病床上。
之前的他仿佛做了一个很长的梦，梦的内容有些扯淡，有系统，有nba，他还代替了奥尼尔去揍了巴克利一顿，还在01年的总决赛上，亲手扼杀了‘答案’那唯一一场总决赛的胜利。
左手床边一个容颜绝美，聘婷秀丽的女人，正坐在椅子上拿着一本书，津津有味看的入迷，连他这个病人醒来都没有注意到。
漂亮的容貌总能留给人比较深刻的印象，华十二一眼就认出，这女人正是和自己相亲的那个名叫洛云的女人。
不过此时洛云的发型和着装都发生了变化，气质也因为打扮的不同而有所改变。
相亲的时候，她是披肩长发，穿的是白色v领衬衫和蓝色半身裙，展现出来的气质是知性、优雅。
而现在她梳着马尾，换上热裤、体恤，给人一种性感、俏皮的感觉。
华十二记起车祸发生的时候，洛云和自己一样都在现场，想来即便不是她送自己来医院的，也是跟来照看自己的吧。
只是不知道这妞怎么这么爱美，还抽空换了身衣服。
忽然他心中一动，一个可怕念头涌入脑海，难道自己昏迷了很长时间？
可是看到了病房墙壁上的电子日历，他这才松了一口气，还是相亲这一天，时间只过去了两个小时而已。
转头看向洛云，顿时被眼前的一幕吸引到了。
只见阳光透过玻璃窗映射在女人迷人的脸庞上，那时而微微抖动的长睫毛，宝石般的眼睛，透出迷人的光彩。
阳光、美人，在这一刻构成了一副美丽的画面，洛云仿佛是那被光芒环绕的画中仙子，华十二不由得看的有些出神了。
可是下一刻，就见洛云眼睛没有离开漫画，她的纤纤玉手却慢慢凑到唇边，将一根没有点燃的女士雪茄咬在嘴里。
华十二一头黑线，感觉刚才那美丽的画面，瞬间就被这根女士雪茄击的粉碎。
这妞竟然想在医院抽烟，更夸张的是抽的是雪茄，这反差也太大了吧。

回过神来的他又注意到让他颠覆三观的一幕。
因为洛云手中那本让她看到入迷的书，名字没看清楚，但封皮上的卡通美女却非常清晰。
再看洛云的大眼睛，此时华十二感觉那闪现的哪里是什么宝石般的光彩啊，分明是老司机看到美女时所流露出的那种目光嘛，怪不得那么眼熟。
眼前美女的形象在他心里瞬间便来了个180度大转弯。
华十二瀑布汗加成吉思汗的同时，心中也猜测，这洛云之前说相亲是为了应付家人应该是真的。
洛云将那女士雪茄咬住，然后不知道从哪里摸出一个打火机来，这个过程中，她的眼睛依然没有离开那本漫画书。
眼看着这妞就要点燃雪茄，华十二不由的无奈轻咳一声，打算提醒对方自己醒了。
可是咳嗽了两下之后，那妞依旧看着书直流口水，愣是没有听见，华十二这才不得不坐起身，无奈招呼道：
“美女，你要在病房里抽烟会触发烟雾报警器的！”
他这一开口才惊醒沉浸在yy那啥书中的洛云。

His eyelids trembled as Hua Twelve woke up from his coma. He slowly opened his eyes and saw a white gleam. He was in a ward. At this time, he was lying on a hospital bed.
He seemed to have had a long dream before. The content of the dream was a bit nonsense, involving systems and the NBA. He even replaced O'Neal to beat up Barkley. In the 2001 Finals, he personally killed the answer's only victory in the finals.
Beside the bed on the left, a beautiful and beautiful woman was sitting on a chair holding a book. She was reading with gusto, and she didn't even notice that the patient woke up.
Beautiful appearance can always leave a deep impression on people. Hua Twelve recognized at a glance that this woman was the woman named Luo Yun with whom he had a blind date.
However, Luo Yun's hairstyle and clothing have changed at this time, and his temperament has also changed due to the different dressing.
During the blind date, she had long hair and wore a white V-neck shirt and a blue skirt. Her temperament was intellectual and elegant.
But now she has her hair in a ponytail, put on hot pants and a T-shirt, giving people a sexy and playful look.
Hua Twelve remembered that when the car accident happened, Luo Yun was at the scene like him. He thought that even if she didn't send him to the hospital, she would have followed him to take care of him.
I just don’t know why this girl loves beauty so much and even took the time to change her clothes.
Suddenly, something stirred in his heart, and a terrible thought came into his mind. Could it be that he had been unconscious for a long time?
But when he saw the electronic calendar on the wall of the ward, he breathed a sigh of relief. It was still the day of the blind date, and only two hours had passed.
Turning to look at Luo Yun, he was immediately attracted by the scene in front of him.
I saw the sunlight reflected through the glass window on the woman's charming face. At that time, the long eyelashes trembling slightly and the gem-like eyes revealed a charming brilliance.
The sunshine and the beauty formed a beautiful picture at this moment. Luo Yun seemed to be the fairy in the painting surrounded by light. Hua Twelve couldn't help but look a little lost in thought.
But the next moment, Luo Yun's eyes did not leave the comic, but her delicate hand slowly came to her lips, biting an unlit lady's cigar in her mouth.
Hua Twelve had a black streak on his head, feeling that the beautiful scene just now was instantly shattered by this lady's cigar.
This girl actually wanted to smoke in the hospital, and even more exaggeratedly, she was smoking a cigar. The contrast was too great.
When he came back to his senses, he noticed a scene that subverted his outlook on life.
Because of the book in Luo Yun's hand that fascinated her, she couldn't see the name clearly, but the cartoon beauty on the cover was very clear.
Looking at Luo Yun's big eyes, Hua Twelve felt that there was some kind of gem-like brilliance flashing there. It was clearly the kind of look that an old driver showed when he saw a beautiful woman. No wonder he looked so familiar.
The image of the beautiful woman in front of him instantly made a 180-degree turn in his mind.
While Hua Twelve Waterfall Khan joined Genghis Khan, he also guessed in his heart that Luo Yun's previous statement that the blind date was to deal with his family should be true.
Luo Yun bit the woman's cigar, and then took out a lighter from nowhere. During the process, her eyes still did not leave the comic book.
Seeing that this girl was about to light a cigar, Hua Twelve couldn't help but cough softly, intending to remind the other party that he was awake.
But after coughing twice, the girl was still drooling while reading the book, but she didn't hear anything. Hua Twelve had to sit up and said helplessly:
"Beauty, if you smoke in the ward, you will touchSend out smoke alarms! "
Only when he opened his mouth did he wake up Luo Yun who was immersed in YY's book.
